correctness.rationale: The normalized uniform spherical annulus has E X=0 and covariance kappa^-1 I with kappa=(d+2)(1-r^d)/(1-r^(d+2)); therefore the affine L2 projection's reproducing kernel is 1+kappa x·y. Convex symmetry of the row integral and existence of negative kernel values show precisely outer-sphere rows maximize its L-infinity norm, with sign-of-kernel extremizer. Ball-coordinate beta density and radial subtraction give the stated H_d incomplete-beta norm formula. The scaled radius S_r=kappa R_r has strictly rising lower and strictly falling upper support endpoints with density proportional to s^(d-1); its CDF has a single crossing and its mean strictly decreases. Thus it strictly dominates later radii in stop-loss order on the relevant thresholds; strict convexity of phi(s)=E(sU_1-1)_+ for s>1 proves L_d(r) strictly decreases to the sphere endpoint. Taylor at r=0 yields leading beta coefficient times r^d. Uniform radial concentration and uniform sphere-coordinate Gaussian limit give sup_r|L_d(r)/sqrt(d)-sqrt(2/pi)|->0. Independent radial/sphere quadrature checked d=2,3,4 at several radii and d=3 endpoints 253/125 and 5/3, not an all-dimensional proof.
